verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both keep the ram skull, the yellow bar and the quote faithfully, but they stack everything in the top 85% and leave a large empty band at the bottom of the tall canvas. The attribution also sits a couple of pixels left of the quote's left edge. The only difference is the attribution's spacing. A leaves a wider gap under the quote, so the credit looks detached. B keeps it tighter, closer to the original's grouping.
